# GIFt-Converter

GIFt-Converter is a free open-source tool for converting batches of video files into GIFs.

- Project type: hybrid desktop and web tool
- Desktop build: Electron app for Windows
- Web build: browser conversion with ffmpeg.wasm
- Main repo: https://github.com/algzl/GIFt-converter
- Website: https://ycswu.co/gift-converter/
- Latest release API: https://api.github.com/repos/algzl/GIFt-converter/releases/latest

Supported input formats include:
MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WEBM, M4V, WMV, FLV, MPEG, MPG, 3GP, TS, MTS, M2TS, OGV, OGM, QT, ASF, VOB, MXF, F4V, RM, RMVB, DIVX

Outputs:
GIF, ZIP

Release folders in this project:
- GIFt-Converter/web
- GIFt-Converter/windows app
- GIFt-Converter/itch build

The web build requires http://localhost or https:// for conversion. file:// is preview-only.
